_key_note: Ticket ids are KEY-001, KEY-002 ... issued in order, never reused. The filename is the id, and threads, decisions `sources:` citations and run records all point at tickets by it.
_repos_note: kind: team | wiki | code | reference, or a list when one repo is two - a team that keeps tickets and library together declares ["team", "wiki"]; the scaffold makes two. A code repo belongs to exactly one team; a reference repo belongs to none and is never ticketed or worktree'd - a lane that writes there is an over-scope finding. base: the branch the checkout is KEPT on; Wright never checks anything else out there. pin + upstream: reference repos only - when the upstream moves past the pin, one note in the team inbox; a person re-pins. protected: code repos - paths no lane touches without a person's yes; G1 reads it at kickoff. index: every path is in one of three states: not indexed (exclude), searchable only (search_only) or read for entities; where two patterns match the last one wins, and this file is read after Ken's built-in patterns; code and run records are searchable only. Set once here for everyone. Add keys freely; kind and base may not be removed.
_models_note: The model each size runs on. The team sets it once here. It is the same on every machine. In Wright it is Settings > This team > Models. Change it the way you change any other setting on that tab. XS runs on Sonnet. Every other size runs on Opus. Each step runs at the effort the preset names for it: low, medium, high or xhigh. The wright key is Wright at the board, which also runs on Opus. Nothing runs on a model below Sonnet. A preset never names a model.

controls.moved: {{page pinned to a commit known to have moved}}

_drift_sweep_note: The standing sweep: the drift check run on this schedule across every page, not only at a ticket's close. Each run writes a run record. When two intervals pass with no run record, the missed sweep is raised at the next ticket close. A run is void if either control comes back wrong: the known-moved page reads clean, or the known-clean page reads flagged. A run that examined fewer pages than min_pages is void too. A Finding (a cited path gone, a ruling's source gone) is a ticket. A Judgment (a diff that touches a constant, a signature or a line the page cites) is one row on the Ideas list (ideas/). A page nobody has verified for thirty days gets a row there too. Wright raises the row, with its source set to sweep. The row names the page and the mismatch.
_worktrees_note: One per ticket, on its own branch, cut at claim - and never inside the indexed folder. Measured 2026-09-04: nine worktrees under one code folder held 218,383 files against 129,421 in the real repos.
_note: critical_context is a budget. A file belongs here only if removing it changes what an agent does - run the same ticket with and without it and compare. Anything that cannot show that is costing tokens for reassurance.
